definitions.primary: By100 native joint4D position<20 and wrapped angle<pi/9, checked every5 raw; first success, no action0 relabeling.
definitions.secondary: By25 is a prespecified secondary horizon. Capped25 costs25 for both failures and successes exactlyat25; success flags remain separate.
definitions.units: One model token contains5 raw commands. Future horizon stays5 tokens; real history has1/2/3 available frames, not future observations.
definitions.weighting: Each arm uses the same50 windows. Baseline reused once;150 new runs are not150 independent tasks. Trajectory summaries retain dependence; no bootstrap/p-values.
definitions.information: History arms have more own-episode observed frames and fixed executed action tokens; no extra physical interactions. More encoded/context frames mean unequal compute despite equal GD100/horizon.
definitions.deadline: For rounds0..4 deadline uses relative forecast slot5-round; from round5 onwards native all-horizon weighting. History alone keeps original staged switch.
definitions.factorial: B=native, D=deadline, H=history3, HD=history3_deadline. D_at_H0=D-B; D_at_H1=HD-H; H_at_D0=H-B; H_at_D1=HD-D; interaction=HD-H-D+B. Four outcomes per same draw, not200 independent samples.
definitions.limitations: Methods are deployment diagnostics on consumed development data. Neither success differences nor descriptive paired counts establish originality, SOTA, or a unique mechanism.
